manualReview.scope: Model/editor Quality v3 remediation review of EN-A1-L-0137; not an independent human or real-learner test.

englishNaturalness.evidence: ‘This month isn't busy.’ and ‘Next month isn't busy either.’ are natural bounded calendar-time descriptions.

persianMeaningQuality.evidence: month is consistently «ماه» and the negative polarity is preserved in Persian.

pedagogicalClarity.evidence: Dialogue-dependent tasks are ordered after exposure, duplicate exact-sentence assessment is practice-only, and hidden-answer retrieval remains the strongest evidence.

distractorQuality.evidence: Distractors are grammatical, natural and contrast month/time or polarity; each choice now has explicit teaching feedback and model distractor audit where English choices are graded.

dialoguePlausibility.evidence: Generic story metadata was replaced where needed by scene copy grounded in the canonical setting and turns.

difficultyFit.evidence: One lexical target is paired with a short already-introduced present-be negative pattern.

repetitionUsefulness.evidence: Repeated exact target sentences may remain for practice, but only the strongest occurrence is scored; this reduces false mastery from repeated identical answers.

transferQuality.evidence: Transfer changes the calendar reference from this month to next month.

overallCoherence.evidence: Outcome, story, familiar grammar and tasks all align to calendar scheduling.

learnerExperience.evidence: Runtime ordering and answer tolerance were improved, but no real learner test is claimed.

runtimeAssetGrounding.evidence: No image/photo/visual is claimed; all listening sources are audioRequired turns exposed earlier.

limitations: No independent human or real learner test has been performed.
Only the calendar-unit sense of month is assessed.
